bar.title: Filter your journal
bar.description: Times use {timeZone}. Dates use the closing day, or opening day for open trades. All selected conditions must match.
bar.buttonHint: Filter by dates, symbols, strategy, outcome, and more. All selected conditions must match.

hints.from: First included date. Closed trades use their closing day; open trades use their opening day.
hints.to: Last included date. Dates follow the journal time zone.
hints.strategy: Include trades assigned to this playbook. All includes trades without a playbook.
hints.symbols: Include these symbols. Separate multiple symbols with commas, for example AAPL, NVDA.
hints.excludeSymbols: Hide these symbols from the results. Separate multiple symbols with commas.
hints.requiredTags: Filter by tags recorded on your trades. Separate multiple tags with commas.
hints.requiredMistakes: Filter by recorded trading mistakes. Separate multiple mistakes with commas.
hints.reviewStatus: Find trades you have marked reviewed, or those still awaiting review.
hints.r: Trade profit or loss expressed as a multiple of the trade's initial risk.
hints.plannedR: The planned reward relative to the trade's initial risk.
hints.duration: Time between opening and closing a trade, measured in minutes.
